messages:
Maya: heads-up — customer X hit a bunch of 429s this morning. looks like burst credits exhausted and they got a generic 'rate limit exceeded' from the SDK. can we make the error more actionable?
Alex: saw that. the SDK surface currently returns { code: 429, message: 'Rate limit exceeded' } which is meaningless for customers using both org and key quotas.
Ben: agree. we should include which quota fired (per-key vs per-org vs concurrent) and whether it was a burst or steady limit. small payload additions, not a breaking change.
Sasha: proposal: enhance the 429 body with these fields: quota_type, remaining, retry_after_seconds, burst_consumed boolean. eg: 
```json
{
  "code": 429,
  "message": "Quota exceeded",
  "quota_type": "org",
  "remaining": 0,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "burst_consumed": true
}
```
Maya: that would let SDKs show targeted guidance. e.g. "you've hit org burst: try backoff or request a quota raise" vs "your api key exceeded its per-key daily token quota".
Alex: SDKs need consistent keys. can we commit to those field names? also add a telemetry tag in the response headers like `x-rw-quota=org:burst` so console/metrics can correlate.
Ben: i prefer headers+body. headers are cheap for infra and don't require parsing JSON to know which quota fired for routing/alerts. `x-rw-quota: org|key|concurrent;mode=burst`
Sasha: touchpoints: API runtime, dedicated routing, and console messaging. in the console we also need a clearer banner when a workspace is hitting org limits — not the vague "some requests failed". suggestion: banner text: 
"Quota pause: Your workspace has exhausted burst credits. Requests are being throttled. Learn how to reduce token usage or request additional capacity (link)."
Maya: +1. include a clickable 'Investigate' that opens the quota dashboard filtered to that workspace and timeframe. that will reduce support pings.
Alex: question about rollout — we should canary the enhanced body to 10% of hosts and add a feature flag to flip parsing in SDKs. also emit a metric `quota.exceeded.v2=true` so we can track adoption.
Ben: agree on metric. also add a schema version in the body `quota_schema: "v2"` so older SDKs fallback gracefully.
Sasha: action items I can pick up: 1) PR for runtime to add headers+body fields (non-breaking), 2) console banner copy + link target, 3) telemetry event spec. can someone own SDK changes?
Maya: i'll take SDKs (python, js). i'll make them parse the new fields if present and show contextual UI messages. will keep backwards compatibility.
infra-bot: deploy job queued for canary rollout (job id: canary-8432). staging tests passing.
Ben: docs note — need a small doc in "rate-limits" about the new error shape and examples for handling retries + backoff, plus examples for distinguishing org vs key. i can draft it.
Alex: also add a logging suggestion in the SDK: log the `x-rw-quota` header and the `quota_schema` for support traces.
Sasha: timeline: aim for PRs by EOD Wed, canary deploy Thu, monitor telemetry for 72h, then full rollout next Tue if no regressions.
Maya: sounds good. i'll open the SDK PR and link it here.
Ben: i'll create the docs stub and tag infra/observability for dashboard link.
DevEx: thanks all — will prepare a short console tooltip update and coordinate with support for the new messaging. :thumbsup:
Maya: quick note — we should avoid long error messages in the console toast. keep to one short sentence and "Learn more" link to docs.
Alex: +1. keep console actionable and not noisy.
Sasha: ok closing loop. i'll update the rollout checklist and add the metric names to the infra runbook.
Maya: nice work team.
